purpose: Define teacher-card assembly with visible readiness and evidence status.
resolution_order: Resolve China and comparison curricula independently.
For a selected US state, use the registered state overlay when available; do not silently substitute Common Core as the state requirement.
Apply grade/stage filters without forcing equivalence.
Resolve locators, representations and teaching moves.
Apply diagnostic overlays, canonicalise misconception aliases and deduplicate.
Resolve diagnostic evidence depth/overrides separately from curriculum evidence.
Apply localization and assemble visible sections/status labels.

teacher_facing_sections.rule: Show curriculum expectation/placement, not inferred classroom practice.
Show development without implying same-numbered-grade equivalence.
State system-specific use only when evidenced; otherwise call it an instructional option.
Recommend moves for mathematical/evidence reasons, not as national traits.
Keep rationale separate from curriculum requirements.
Describe possible reasoning patterns and display evidence depth; never diagnose from one answer.
Label as a diagnostic probe, not a formal/validated assessment; require explanation or a second probe.
Give one practical option for the Chinese curriculum context without ranking systems.
Show the smallest useful source set, locators and status.

direct_empirical_broad_construct_or_mech.zh-CN: 相关研究支持（具体表述需谨慎）
direct_empirical_broad_construct_or_mech.en: Related direct research; exact wording is narrower

evidence_synthesis.zh-CN: 研究综述/证据指南支持

status_gates.research_required: Do not show as established fact.
status_gates.grade_placement_pending: Show verified Chinese learning stage instead.
status_gates.curriculum_inferred_misconception: Show only as a possible misunderstanding/probe.
status_gates.direct_empirical_misconception: May say research supports the reasoning pattern, but not prevalence or diagnostic certainty.

jurisdiction_rules: Use 中国N年级 only for verified exact Chinese placement; otherwise show 学段.
Use 英格兰 Year N for England.
Use 美国 Common Core Grade N and label it baseline when no state is selected.
Use California/Texas state labels and standards where mapped.
Never translate foreign grade labels into Chinese grade equivalence.
diagnostic_rules: Require at least two pieces of evidence before recording a likely misconception.
Separate conceptual, procedural, fluency, representation and language difficulties.
For bilingual pupils, re-probe with simpler language or Chinese when wording may be the barrier.
Recheck the same structure with different surface details.
copy_rules: Use short headings and plain explanations.
Avoid marketing language, slogans, hype and AI-style filler.
Prefer compare, show, explain, ask, check, represent, calculate and justify.
integrity_checks_before_render: Every factual system statement has a source or explicit pending status.
Every diagnostic misconception displays evidence depth.
Every diagnostic item is visibly a probe, not a validated test.
No legacy PEP is current by default.
State selections do not silently fall back to Common Core as state requirements.
